Department Identity

About the Medical Scientific Research Department (MSRD)

The Medical Scientific Research Department (MSRD) was established at the College of Medicine, Hebron University, to govern, standardize, and catalyze medical scientific research. MSRD acts as both an academic advisory body and the official institutional repository for monitoring peer-reviewed scientific publications originating from faculty members, clinical supervisors, and medical students.

Mission Statement

To foster an ethically grounded, internationally recognized research ecosystem within the College of Medicine by supporting medical students and faculty in producing high-impact clinical and biomedical publications that address regional and global health challenges.

Strategic Vision

To position Hebron University College of Medicine as a premier hub for evidence-based medical research in Palestine, characterized by student-led research integration, high Q1/Q2 journal publication rates, and robust international collaborative networks.

Technical Architecture & Governance Workflow

MSRD operates a structured Google-integrated data pipeline. Submissions are processed via embedded Google Forms, archived in Google Drive & Google Sheets, and rendered directly on this public web interface.

1. Google Forms

Student/Faculty submits article metadata & DOI proof

2. MSRD Verification

Vetting DOI, Indexing, Quartiles & Ethics clearance

3. Master Sheets DB

Verified records saved into structured master repository

4. Auto Analytics

Automatic statistical calculation & indexing metrics

5. Web Observatory

Public visibility, searchable catalog & community feed

Hebron University • Medical Scientific Research Department

YoDoSciRes Forum

HU-YoDoSciRes Forum (Hebron University Young Doctors Scientific Research Forum) is a structured student research initiative operating as an operational arm of the Medical Scientific Research Department. It is designed to activate student research potential under professional academic supervision, providing progressive training, mentorship, research collaboration, publication support, conference preparation and opportunities for academic exchange.

Research Training

Progressive training in research methodology, statistics, literature evaluation and study design.

Research & Publication

Students are connected to supervised research projects and supported toward peer-reviewed scientific output.

Conferences & Collaboration

Preparation for abstracts, oral presentations and posters, together with inter-university scientific collaboration.

Academic integrity: Official activities, curricula, workshops and research pipelines are conducted under senior faculty supervision and departmental oversight. The Forum is intended to provide continuity from year to year rather than function as an unsupervised student club.

Ethics & Research Governance

IRB Submission

Select the appropriate IRB submission pathway before starting data collection. The forms below are separate and should be completed according to the research category.

Supporting Documents — Multiple File Upload

Select several files at once (PDF, Word, images, spreadsheets, etc.). The final transfer will be handled through the selected Google Form/backend.

Important: Google Forms must have a File Upload question configured to accept multiple files for those files to be submitted through the form.

IRB for Graduation Project (Thesis)

Graduation Project research is the research proposal required for the course M-1594 before starting the data collection process. The PI and all Researchers must be from the College of Medicine at Hebron University.

IRB for External Research

External Research is research in which the Principal Investigator (PI) is not affiliated with the College of Medicine at Hebron University.

IRB for Internal Research

Internal Research is research in which the Principal Investigator (PI) is affiliated with the College of Medicine at Hebron University.

Important: Data collection must not begin before the required ethical/IRB approval has been obtained. Use the correct submission category for your study.
